edits.old: - The published contract of P4 rwb-access is in the contract registry: `GET /api/recovery/access/v1/me/session` answers the caller's roles and rights, and the access contract publishes no partner-user read, because partner users are S9's (ASM-0072).
edits.new:
- The published contract of P4 rwb-access is in the contract registry: `GET /api/recovery/access/v1/me/session` answers the caller's roles and rights, and the access contract publishes no partner-user read, because partner users are S9's (ASM-0072).
- The contract version this harness builds and stubs against is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-AD022-ITG-23): the source read fixes only the `/v1` path base, so the run takes the version from the registry entry of each owner contract at the wave entry check, pins it per hop in the report, and fails a hop whose version is absent or does not match (X1).

edits.old: Each stub is generated from the published contract and its version is pinned in the run report, so a contract change shows up as a run failure and not as a silent pass.
edits.new: Each stub is generated from the published contract and its version is pinned in the run report, so a contract change shows up as a run failure and not as a silent pass. The contract fake library version of the two owner stubs is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-AD022-ITG-22): no source read names a published fake version, so the run records the published fake version of each contract from the registry at the wave entry check, pins it in the report beside the contract version, and fails the run when it is absent (X1).
